nodes.title: SG-1.2.1 · Add the zustand dependency to the frontend package.json and lockfile
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/package.json lists react, motion, lucide-react and radix packages but no zustand, and node_modules/zustand is absent. Desired behavior: zustand is a declared runtime dependency and package-lock.json resolves it. Expected result: `import { create } from 'zustand'` resolves in the frontend. Why: the Zustand UI store in SG-1.2 needs it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/frontend/package.json, when parsed, then dependencies.zustand is a semver range string
- Given package-lock.json, when parsed, then packages[''].dependencies.zustand equals the package.json range and packages['node_modules/zustand'] exists with a version
- Given the frontend, when 'zustand' is imported, then create is a function


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/package.json
- In scope: game/frontend/package-lock.json
- Out of scope: Creating useUiStore
- Out of scope: Other dependency changes
- Out of scope: Backend modules
- Preserve: Existing dependency ranges
- Preserve: lockfileVersion 3


## Technical constraints
- Use npm so the lockfile stays lockfileVersion 3
- zustand goes in dependencies, not devDependencies


## Definition of done
- zustand is declared and locked
- Unit test for the dependency passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · zustand is declared in package.json and locked in package-lock.json
nodes.body:
Context: no zustand entry in game/frontend/package.json or package-lock.json. Desired behavior: add the dependency with npm so both files agree. Expected result: manifest range matches the lockfile root entry and a resolved node_modules/zustand package exists. Why: later store work imports it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package.json, when read, then dependencies.zustand matches ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+
- Given package-lock.json, when read, then the root package dependency range equals package.json and node_modules/zustand has a version
- Given the frontend, when zustand is imported, then create is exported as a function


## Scope
- In scope: zustand entry in package.json and package-lock.json
- Out of scope: Store code
- Preserve: Other dependencies unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Run npm install from game/frontend


## Definition of done
- Both files contain zustand
- Verify unit passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

Read ../package-lock.json; assert packages[''].dependencies.zustand equals the package.json value and packages['node_modules/zustand'].version is a non-empty string.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts

steps.action: Add a test that does `const mod = await import('zustand')` and asserts typeof mod.create === 'function'.
